title.narrative: Development of Risk Register and EW SOPs

description.narrative:
NADFOR currently lacks two essential institutional instruments critical for effective disaster management: a comprehensive Organizational Risk Register and a standardized EarlyWarning standard operational policy (SOP). The absence of a structured risk register limits the organization’s ability to identify, categorize, and mitigate strategic, operational/program, financial, and compliance risks. Meanwhile, without a formal Early Warning SOP, there is no standardized process for alert activation, communication, and coordination, which can lead to inconsistent decision-making, delayed responses, and uncoordinated emergency operations.
These gaps undermine NADFOR’s operational effectiveness. Departments operate with inconsistent workflows, documentation is limited, and emergency actions can be delayed or uncoordinated. This affects internal governance, reduces predictability, and compromises accountability, bothto national authorities and the public it serves. Strengthening these systems is essential to enhance governance, improve disaster preparedness, and ensure timely and effective response to climate-related shocks affecting Somaliland’s population.
NADFOR proposesa focused 30-day institutional strengthening project consisting of twoparallel initiatives, implemented by two independent consultants working simultaneously from Day 1 of entering with contract with NADFOR. Iniitative 1: Development of an Integrated Organizational Risk Register • Develop a unified institutional risk register aligned with international standards(e.g., ISO 31000) • Strengthen NADFOR’s ability to identify, score, and mitigate institutional risks • Establish a monitoring, reporting, and documentation mechanism for institutional risk management Initiative 2: Development of Early Warning SOP • Establish a standardized Early Warning SOP fortimely activation, alert dissemination, and coordination with national and regional actors • Strengthen consistency, predictability, and communication across NADFOR units during emergencies
NADFOR will institutionalize the Organizational Risk Register and Early Warning SOP by integrating them into: Internal governance tools, Departmental workflows AND Regular reporting and monitoring procedures

participating-org.narrative: Somaliland National Disaster Preparedness and Food Reserve Authority( NADFOR) was established in 2003 but legally passed in June 2007 through parliament, house of elders and signed by the President of Somaliland , Nafor's goal is to prevent frequent occurrence ofdisasters, droughts and reduce vulnerability of communities by improving sustainable coping capacities to decrease overall impact to disasters on lives and livelihoods of Somaliland communities. NADFOR's Strategic Objective to become effective and efficient institution managing early warning systems, information sharing and dissemination advocating for disasters and related environmental crisis for strategic decision making and action in the country.
